question: Contá los ensayos de linfoma con fecha de inicio en 2020 o después que incluyen rituximab.

attempts.query:
SELECT count(DISTINCT s.nct_id)
FROM aact.studies s
WHERE s.start_date >= DATE '2020-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.browse_conditions bc WHERE bc.nct_id = s.nct_id AND bc.downcase_mesh_term = 'lymphoma')
  AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.interventions i WHERE i.nct_id = s.nct_id AND i.name ILIKE '%rituximab%')
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.intervention_other_names o WHERE o.nct_id = s.nct_id AND o.name ILIKE '%rituximab%'))
